_meta.purpose: H4 (presentation) corpus inventory: catalog 23 HELD immunopeptidome/proteome deposits + fetch confirmed-missing backlog. Corrects W7 'single-HLA / 1 cell line' claim.
_meta.modality_key: HLA-I = MHC class-I eluted-ligand immunopeptidome; HLA-II = MHC class-II; P = whole/total proteome; L = ligandome(immunopeptidome)
_meta.paired_definition: SAME-FLASK PAIRED = proteome AND immunopeptidome measured on the same physical samples in the same deposit (P+L)
